title: A City Mobilizes Against a Stubborn Health Threat: Mosquitoes
summary_full: The city of Belém in northern Brazil was overwhelmed by an outbreak of dengue two years ago. An all-out municipal effort has reduced cases and may offer lessons to American cities.
